name: Al'Aketh Assassins

angles.text: As a Rogue, you know the focus and precision it takes to face lethal killers like the Al'Aketh.

faq.answer: You are asked to eliminate a lethal force of Al'Aketh operatives. A scout will record your aid in a report for Valanaar.
Scouts call the Al'Aketh assassins stone-cold killers. They work together as a dangerous strike force.
Valanaar is a settlement at the island's southeastern edge and a base for its peacekeepers. The scout plans to report your aid there.
The Al'Aketh assassins threaten scouts and travelers in the area. Defeating them protects allied forces from their lethal attacks.
faq.q: Why must the Al'Aketh assassins be dealt with?

faq.answer: After the fight, the scout prepares to report to Valanaar and record your aid.
faq.q: What happens after dealing with the assassins?

faq.answer: A scout in the field acknowledges your help against the Al'Aketh assassins and notes your contribution for command.
faq.q: Who acknowledges your aid in defeating the assassins?

sections.body: Scouts in the field call the Al'Aketh assassins stone-cold killers. They move together with ruthless purpose, putting nearby scouts and travelers in grave danger. You face a perilous fight before they can strike their targets.
sections.title: A Deadly Threat

sections.body: After the Al'Aketh force is defeated, the scout is relieved to find you alive. Your timely aid will go into an official report for Valanaar.
sections.title: Reporting to Valanaar

summary: A scout asks you to end the Al'Aketh Assassins' deadly threat. Your survival and aid will be recorded for Valanaar.
